en.headline: West Kowloon police ticket four taxi drivers in checks
en.dek: Officers said Monday's operation produced four summonses, covering refused hires, extra phones and missing displays.
body: The West Kowloon traffic enforcement and control team carried out an operation on Monday targeting taxi offences, police said. The operation was coded KICKSTARTER.

Police said they issued four traffic summonses. The four drivers are accused, respectively, of refusing a hire, placing more than two mobile telecommunications devices while driving, failing to display the taximeter, and failing to display the taxi driver identity card on the document holder.

Police said the operation was continuing and that officers would keep enforcing the rules to protect residents and visitors. People who see a suspected taxi offence were asked to note the time, place, licence plate, driver's name and route, and report it to police.

zh.headline: 西九龍打擊的士違例 四名司機被發傳票
zh.dek: 警方稱周一行動發出四張傳票，涉拒載、駕駛時放置多於兩部手機，以及未展示計程錶和司機證。
body: 西九龍總區交通部執行及管制組人員周一在區內進行代號「駒始」的執法行動，主要針對的士交通違例事項。
警方表示，行動共發出四張交通傳票。四名的士司機分別涉嫌拒載、駕駛時放置多於兩部流動電訊裝置、沒有展示的士計程指示器，以及沒有把的士司機證展示在證件架上。
警方稱行動仍在進行，會繼續執法以保障市民及旅客。警方呼籲，如發現涉嫌的士違例，應記下時間、地點、車牌、司機姓名及行車路線，並向警方舉報。
